title: Figures 9-10: MRI image distortion, custom microwire electrode assembly, and T2 maps
description: Figure 9 shows (A) a distorted MRI image caused by metallic bone screws, (B) photographs of a custom microelectrode array and connector piece, and (C) an improved rat brain MRI after replacing hardware with compatible parts. Figure 10, "Example of T2 Variability," shows two rows of color-coded rat brain T2 maps with a color scale bar, where ovals indicate electrode sites; row A (rat 16, day 7) shows elevated values near the implant and row B (rat 18, day 30) shows no difference between hemispheres (Reference 51).
